subject.title: [Architecture] Enforce strict typings for command payloads in packages/gateway-protocol

question: Should Gateway request typing cover built-in RPCs only with a plugin fallback, or establish a public type-augmentation contract for plugin-registered RPC methods?
rationale: The built-in payload schemas can support strict typing, but the runtime registry intentionally accepts plugin-defined method names, so the permanent extension boundary needs maintainer intent before a broad migration.

options.title: Built-ins plus plugin fallback
options.body: Type built-in RPCs exhaustively while preserving a documented generic handler path for plugin-registered methods.

options.title: Public plugin augmentation
options.body: Add a supported declaration-merging or registry-generic contract so plugins can contribute method-specific payload types.

options.title: Internal handlers only
options.body: Keep RequestFrame generic and add local generic handler helpers without creating a central method map.

recommendation.title: Built-ins plus plugin fallback
recommendation.body: Type built-in RPCs exhaustively while preserving a documented generic handler path for plugin-registered methods.

likelyOwner.reason: The recent method registry architecture and most of the protocol history route through this contributor.
